sources.title: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking model card
sources.evidence: Exact checkpoint is Apache-2.0, openly downloadable, and contains the reasoning Thinker with text output. Its Thinking evaluation includes visual reasoning and BFCL-v3 function calling (63.2).

sources.title: Thinking checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Audio output is disabled. thinker_config contains audio, vision, and MoE text configurations; the text decoder has 128 experts, 8 selected per token and max_position_embeddings=65536. No Talker configuration is present.

sources.title: Thinking checkpoint weight index
sources.evidence: Fetched successfully through HTTPS after the browser fetch failed. metadata.total_parameters explicitly equals 31719205488. Weight prefixes are thinker.audio_tower, thinker.visual, thinker.model, and thinker.lm_head; no Talker/MTP/Code2Wav weights.

sources.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report, version 1
sources.evidence: Table 1 lists the Thinker MoE decoder as 30B-A3B, audio encoder as 650M, and vision encoder as 540M. Talker, MTP and Code2Wav are separate components. The dated September 22, 2025 report explicitly names the publicly released Thinking variant.

sources.title: Qwen3-Omni official repository
sources.evidence: Identifies Alibaba Cloud as developer and announces Qwen3-Omni release on 2025-09-22; model table explicitly includes the Thinking checkpoint.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud.

family.note: Qwen3-Omni belongs to the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official dated release news and same-day report naming Thinking; repository creation is not used as release evidence.

open_weights.note: Public downloadable checkpoint and weight index.

license.note: Model card and report identify Apache 2.0 for this release.

parameters_b.note: Complete published Thinking checkpoint: 31,719,205,488 parameters divided by 1e9. Includes perception encoders and text decoder; excludes absent speech-generation components. The nominal 30B label is not the checkpoint total.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal active parameter count of the Thinker MoE text decoder. It does not include input-dependent audio/vision encoder work; the sources do not give a single active count for the entire multimodal checkpoint.

architecture.note: Thinker text decoder is MoE; audio and vision encoders are additional components. Thinking excludes the Talker found in Instruct.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint text configuration max_position_embeddings; not a Flash API limit.

modalities.note: Exact variant is text-output only; vision examples/config support images as well as video.

reasoning.note: Thinking variant explicitly uses chain-of-thought reasoning.

tool_call.note: Exact Thinking checkpoint is evaluated on the BFCL-v3 function-calling benchmark (63.2).

description.value: Multimodal reasoning model accepting text, images, video, and audio with text output
description.note: Supported and appropriately specific to Thinking.

patch.notes: The Thinking checkpoint has 31,719,205,488 parameters, including audio and vision encoders plus its MoE text decoder. The nominal 30B total and 3B active labels describe the Thinker decoder; 3B is not a complete multimodal active count. Thinking contains no Talker, MTP, or Code2Wav speech-generation components.

proposed_fields.component_count_note: Paper Table 1 uses nominal component sizes; do not sum these rounded figures to replace the exact checkpoint total. The complete multimodal active count is not reported.

summary: Correct complete checkpoint total from nominal decoder-only 30B to the weight index's exact 31.719205488B. Confirm 3B as nominal active Thinker decoder count, with explicit scope; multimodal-wide active count remains unspecified. Confirm remaining baseline fields, including text-only output and 65,536 context.
